blocks.text: CALAPAN CITY, Oriental Mindoro — The Diocese of Imus has called on parishes to organize activities that promote youth participation in the Catholic Church as it prepares to observe Local World Youth Day, Youth Ministry Awareness Week, and National Youth Day from November 22 to 29. In Circular Letter No. 47, Series of 2026, dated November 19, Bishop Reynaldo Evangelista directed the clergy, consecrated persons, and lay faithful to observe the celebrations as part of the Church’s commitment to the pastoral care and formation of young people.
